sections.heading: Personality Snapshot
sections.html:
Leo shines by creating. The impulse is to express, lead, and warm—to make something worth gathering around. At best: loyal, courageous, generous. At worst: prideful, dramatic, attention-hungry. The craft is centering heart over ego and letting the work speak.

Leo themes live in the 5th house (joy, romance, creativity) balanced by the 11th house (friends, networks, causes). Track aspects to your ruler—the Sun—like Sun trine Jupiter (amplified confidence), Sun square Saturn (ego vs. accountability), or Moon conjunction Sun (feelings fuse with identity).

Opposite sign: Aquarius—the axis from “my spark” to “our system.” Learn the building blocks in astrology charts or generate a free birth chart.

✅ Strengths

  • Warm leadership; gives credit and courage
  • Creative stamina; keeps showing up to the canvas
  • Loyal protector of people and projects

⚠️ Friction Points

  • Pride armor; struggles to receive feedback
  • Performs instead of listens when insecure
  • Over-identifies with applause or outcomes

🧭 Growth Moves

  • Practice “spotlight share”: ask, amplify, invite
  • Separate self-worth from metrics
  • Keep a private practice no one can like or judge

sections.heading: How Leo Energy Behaves
sections.html:
Daily Life

  • Shows love through effort, gifts, and hype
  • Thrives with stages—boardroom, studio, kitchen
  • Needs play, applause and honest critique

Under Stress

  • Takes things personally; performs louder
  • Hot/cold with attention as fuel
  • Reset: service first, story second

Somatic Tells

  • Chest/heart tension when pride is poked
  • Back/spine asks for strength + mobility
  • Breath widens with laughter and art time

sections.heading: Love & Sex
sections.html:
Dating a Leo

  • Plan celebratory dates: shows, dinners, creative workshops
  • Compliments land—make them specific and true
  • Honest, kind feedback beats silence

Sex with Leo

  • Playful, generous, theatrically affectionate
  • Consent = enthusiastic and ongoing
  • Atmosphere matters; think lighting + music

Attachment Triggers

  • Public criticism or cool dismissals
  • Ignored efforts; no appreciation loop
  • Inconsistent affection—name needs clearly

sections.heading: Work & Money
sections.html:
Natural Lanes

  • Leadership, performance, brand/creative direction
  • Hospitality, entertainment, education for impact
  • Any arena where courage + heart are visible

Money Style

  • Spends on quality + experiences
  • Budget “treats” on purpose; automate buffers
  • Invests in craft, gear, and reputation

Team Edge

  • Rallies morale; goes first in hard moments
  • Protects standards without killing play
  • Mentors by notice → name → nurture

sections.heading: Growth Practices
sections.html:
Journal Prompts

  • Where can I serve before I shine?
  • What feedback (from whom) would make me better?
  • What private practice keeps me grounded?

Bodywork

  • Spine strength + mobility; heart-rate play
  • Breath ladders to soften chest tension
  • Sunlight + art time = nervous system food

Ritual

  • Weekly “gratitude shoutouts” to your crew
  • Monthly stage: publish, present, or perform
  • Post-win humility practice: share the credit

sections.heading: Leo Decans
sections.html:
Decan I (≈ Jul 23–Aug 1) — Saturn

  • Serious creator; patient with process
  • Guard against self-judgment posing as standards

Decan II (≈ Aug 2–Aug 11) — Jupiter

  • Big-hearted, generous, celebratory
  • Mind the budget and bandwidth

Decan III (≈ Aug 12–Aug 22) — Mars

  • Fiery competitor; bold stage presence
  • Channel heat into practice, not people
